title: fix: support nested view config format in console ObjectView
body:
CRM calendar view renders with wrong field mappings because the console `renderListView` only reads flat view config properties (`viewDef.startDateField`) but `@objectstack/spec` defines them nested (`viewDef.calendar.startDateField`).

This causes events to show as "Untitled" with incorrect dates, since `titleField` falls back to `'name'` and `startDateField` falls back to `'due_date'` — neither of which exist on event records.

### Changes

- **`apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx`** — Check nested config (`viewDef.<viewType>?.<prop>`) before flat fallbacks for all view types: kanban, calendar, timeline, map, gallery, gantt, chart

```diff
- startDateField: viewDef.startDateField || viewDef.dateField || 'due_date',
+ startDateField: viewDef.calendar?.startDateField || viewDef.startDateField || viewDef.dateField || 'due_date',
```

- **`apps/console/src/__tests__/CalendarNestedConfig.test.tsx`** — Integration test using CRM-style nested calendar config, verifying correct field mapping and no "Untitled" fallback
